note.simple: Sent through the air in your phone’s own seats. The tower checks every piece arrived and asks again if one got lost.
note.technical: Sent on the resource blocks the gNB granted this phone; HARQ resends lost blocks and PDCP encrypts the payload.

rnti.about: The tower’s short name for this phone in this cell (it scrambles the scheduling, not a header byte).

lcid.name: Logical channel
lcid.about: MAC subheader: which channel (a data bearer here).

rlcsn.name: RLC sequence number
rlcsn.about: Puts segments in order and asks again for lost ones (ARQ).

pdcpsn.name: PDCP sequence number
pdcpsn.about: Numbers packets for the radio encryption and for handovers.

qfi.name: QoS flow (SDAP)
qfi.about: Which QoS flow the packet belongs to; the same number rides in the GTP tunnel.
